name: Watt's Up
tagline: See how much solar your roof could produce, save and offset, from satellite imagery and irradiance data.

awards: Best Overall Hack [Courtesy of Amplitude, Anthropic, OpenAI]

problem: People want clean energy but getting a reliable solar estimate takes weeks of outreach.
solution: Segments roofs in satellite imagery with a vision model, combines NASA irradiance data, and estimates production, savings and carbon offset instantly.
demo_moment: Team-described: enter an address and see the roof's solar potential.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Overall Hack [Courtesy of Amplitude, Anthropic, OpenAI]” among 195 submissions.
Uses existing public data that is fragmented and technical.

lessons: Make public scientific data answer one personal question.
